scripts.text:
- Wait a minute !! -
- Currently you're carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please try again -
- after you lose some weight. -
scripts.translation:
- 等等！！ -
- 您現在攜帶的物品 -
- 太多了。 -
- 請在減輕負重後 -
- 再試一次。 -

scripts.text:
[Lime Evenor]
Thanks to many adventurers visiting our Eden Group, we've recently prepared a new version of Eden Group Mark for our visitors.
And it is also possible to exchange old version of Eden Group Mark into a new one.
scripts.translation:
[萊姆·艾弗諾]
感謝眾多冒險者蒞臨樂園團，我們最近為訪客準備了一版新的樂園團徽章。
您也可以將舊版樂園團徽章兌換成新版。

scripts.text:
[Lime Evenor]
Though it has a slight time delay, this new version of Eden Group Mark will send you back to current saved location.
Would you like to exchange yours?
scripts.translation:
[萊姆·艾弗諾]
雖然會有輕微的時間延遲，但這版新的樂園團徽章會將您傳送回當前儲存的位置。
您想要兌換嗎？

scripts.text: Sure
scripts.translation: 當然

scripts.text: I'm good.
scripts.translation: 不用了

scripts.text:
[Lime Evenor]
What possible reason would you have... to not exchange?
scripts.translation:
[萊姆·艾弗諾]
您有什麼理由...不兌換呢？

scripts.text:
[Lime Evenor]
There you go. Come back again~
scripts.translation:
[萊姆·艾弗諾]
給您。歡迎再次光臨~

scripts.text:
[Lime Evenor]
People who follow their dreams and romances listen to me. We are representatives of the paradise called 'The garden of Eden' called the Eden group . There is no place like this anywhere.
Hello. Can I help you?
scripts.translation:
[萊姆·艾弗諾]
追隨夢想與浪漫的人們，請聽我說。我們是名為“伊甸園”的樂園團的代表。世上沒有第二個這樣的地方。
您好。有什麼可以幫您的嗎？

scripts.text: What is Eden group?
scripts.translation: 什麼是樂園團？

scripts.text: Join the Eden Group.
scripts.translation: 加入樂園團

scripts.text: Register new mission.
scripts.translation: 登記新任務

scripts.text: Search for missions.
scripts.translation: 搜尋任務

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Lime Evenor]
Eden Group is a group that helps people who are suffering from distresses in Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[萊姆·艾弗諾]
樂園團是一個幫助米德加爾特中遭受苦難之人的團體。

scripts.text:
[Lime Evenor]
If people need help, we put up the case on the bulletin board and introduce it to our members who are eager to help those in need.
scripts.translation:
[萊姆·艾弗諾]
如果有人需要幫助，我們會將案件釋出在公告板上，並介紹給那些渴望助人為樂的成員。

scripts.text:
[Lime Evenor]
Eden members will review the missions and help those who post them up.
Members do these missions for rewards.
scripts.translation:
[萊姆·艾弗諾]
樂園團的成員會審閱任務並幫助釋出任務的人。
成員通過完成任務來獲取獎勵。

scripts.text:
[Lime Evenor]
If you are not too familiar with Midgard, this is a great way to explore the world.
Or, if you are mature enough, you can travel the world and make new friends while doing missions. Your honorable name will be spread out among lands.
scripts.translation:
[萊姆·艾弗諾]
如果您對米德加爾特還不太熟悉，這是一個探索世界的好方法。
或者，如果您已經足夠成熟，可以在完成任務的同時環遊世界，結交新朋友。您的英名將在各地傳頌。

scripts.text:
[Lime Evenor]
You can be a Eden's member by simply registering with me.
Would you like to join Eden Group?
scripts.translation:
[萊姆·艾弗諾]
您只需向我登記，就可以成為樂園團的成員。
您想要加入樂園團嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, I want to join.
scripts.translation: 是的，我想加入

scripts.text: No, I don't want to join.
scripts.translation: 不，我不想加入

scripts.text:
[Lime Evenor]
Aright. Excellent! Please write down your name here.
scripts.translation:
[萊姆·艾弗諾]
好的。太好了！請在這裡寫下您的名字。

scripts.text:
[Lime Evenor]
Are you done?
Let me see.
scripts.translation:
[萊姆·艾弗諾]
寫好了嗎？
讓我看看。

scripts.text:
[Lime Evenor]
Your name is ^3131FFBo{0}Ba^000000...? Is that right?
Huh? Isn't it??
scripts.translation:
[萊姆·艾弗諾]
您的名字是^3131FFBo{0}Ba^000000...？對嗎？
咦？不對嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lime Evenor]
Hmm, that isn't what you wrote?
Ok, hmm, it seems a bit hard to read.
scripts.translation:
[萊姆·艾弗諾]
嗯，這好像不是您寫的吧？
好吧，嗯，看起來有點難辨認。

scripts.text:
[Lime Evenor]
Would you please write your name again? Please write it ^3131FFClearly^000000.
scripts.translation:
[萊姆·艾弗諾]
請您再寫一次名字好嗎？請寫^3131FF清楚^000000一點。

scripts.text:
[Lime Evenor]
Ah~ ha. You are ^3131FF{0}^000000.
I got it right this time.
scripts.translation:
[萊姆·艾弗諾]
啊哈。您是^3131FF{0}^000000。
這次我讀對了。

scripts.text:
[Lime Evenor]
We already put your name on the list.
Welcome to Eden's group new member!
scripts.translation:
[萊姆·艾弗諾]
我們已經把您的名字登記在名單上了。
歡迎加入樂園團，新成員！

scripts.text:
[Lime Evenor]
Hopefully you can do great work as an Eden's member.
scripts.translation:
[萊姆·艾弗諾]
希望您能在樂園團表現出色。

scripts.text:
[Lime Evenor]
Do you still have questions about Eden Group?
scripts.translation:
[萊姆·艾弗諾]
您還有關於樂園團的問題嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lime Evenor]
You are already a member of Eden Group.
scripts.translation:
[萊姆·艾弗諾]
您已經是樂園團的成員了。

scripts.text:
[Lime Evenor]
Do you want to register some missions that you want us to do?
scripts.translation:
[萊姆·艾弗諾]
您想委託我們執行一些任務嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, I want to register.
scripts.translation: 是的，我想委託

scripts.text: No, I don't.
scripts.translation: 沒有，我沒有。

scripts.text:
[Lime Evenor]
Alrigh. Please write down your name on it.
scripts.translation:
[萊姆·艾弗諾]
好的。請在這裡寫下您的名字。

scripts.text:
[Lime Evenor]
^3131FF{0}^000000.. Is that your name?
Hmm, your handwriting is not clear. I can't read. it
scripts.translation:
[萊姆·艾弗諾]
^3131FF{0}^000000...這是您的名字嗎？
嗯，您的字跡不太清楚。我讀不出來。

scripts.text:
[Lime Evenor]
^3131FF{0}^000000, tell me what you want to register for.
Which map should we go to?
scripts.translation:
[萊姆·艾弗諾]
^3131FF{0}^000000，請告訴我您想委託什麼任務。
我們要去哪個地圖？

scripts.text:
[Lime Evenor]
^3131FFMission Map: {0}^000000
hum, I will note that.
scripts.translation:
[萊姆·艾弗諾]
^3131FF任務地圖：{0}^000000
嗯，我記下了。

scripts.text:
[Lime Evenor]
Please let me know what kind of missions your are lookng for.
It should be briefly like 'Hunt 10 Porings.'
scripts.translation:
[萊姆·艾弗諾]
請告訴我您想要什麼樣的任務。
請簡短描述，例如“狩獵10只波利”。

scripts.text:
[Lime Evenor]
Are you done?
Let me check.
scripts.translation:
[萊姆·艾弗諾]
寫好了嗎？
讓我檢查一下。

scripts.text:
[Lime Evenor]
Huh...........

[Lime Evenor]
Hum.. huh??..................

[Lime Evenor]
I think you should complete one of our missions first before you take up a new mission.
scripts.translation:
[萊姆·艾弗諾]
我認為您應該先完成我們現有的一個任務，然後再接受新任務。

scripts.text:
[Lime Evenor]
^3131FFClient: Lime Evenor^000000
^3131FFMission: Practice your handwriting for one month.^000000
You've got really bad penmanship!
scripts.translation:
[萊姆·艾弗諾]
^3131FF委託人：萊姆·艾弗諾^000000
^3131FF任務：練習一個月的書法。^000000
您的字跡真的很糟糕！

scripts.text:
[Lime Evenor]
^3131FFMission:{0}^000000
Anyway, you are done registering for a new mission.
scripts.translation:
[萊姆·艾弗諾]
^3131FF任務：{0}^000000
總之，您已經完成了新任務的委託。

scripts.text:
[Lime Evenor]
Missions are fully booked. You have to wait for an spot to clear up.
Please kindly wait until your turn.
scripts.translation:
[萊姆·艾弗諾]
任務名額已滿。您必須等待有空位出現。
請耐心等候輪到您。

scripts.text:
[Lime Evenor]
Would like to try some missions as an Eden member?
scripts.translation:
[萊姆·艾弗諾]
想要嘗試作為樂園團成員執行一些任務嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lime Evenor]
Check the right side of the bulletin board, there are various kinds of missions waiting for you.
Please carefully read the mission list and the qualifications and choose one of them.
scripts.translation:
[萊姆·艾弗諾]
請檢視公告欄的右側，那裡有各種各樣的任務在等待您。
請仔細閱讀任務列表和資格，並選擇其中一個。

scripts.text:
[Lime Evenor]
You need to join Eden Group first if you want to do some missions.
scripts.translation:
[萊姆·艾弗諾]
如果您想執行任務，首先需要加入樂園團。

scripts.text:
[Lime Evenor]
If you have any questions please come back again.
scripts.translation:
[萊姆·艾弗諾]
如果您有任何問題，請隨時回來。

scripts.text:
[Eden Teleport Officer]
Those who are wandering around this strange world with aimless eyes listen up and come to me!
Eden group is here to help you and will show you the great future.
scripts.translation:
[樂園團傳送官]
那些在這個奇異世界中漫無目的遊蕩的人，聽好了，過來找我！
樂園團在這裡幫助你們，並向你們展示美好的未來。

scripts.text:
[Eden Teleport Officer]
You have nothing to do but waste your time?
You are eager to do something good but no one offers you work?
Would you like to be a problem solver?
Eden group is here to solve your problem.
scripts.translation:
[樂園團傳送官]
您除了浪費時間無事可做嗎？
您渴望做點好事，卻沒人給您工作？
您想成為解決問題的人嗎？
樂園團在這裡為您解決問題。

scripts.text: Move to Eden Group.
scripts.translation: 前往樂園團

scripts.text: Don't want to talk anymore.
scripts.translation: 不想再談了

scripts.text:
[Eden Teleport Officer]
Let's go to our secret base!
scripts.translation:
[樂園團傳送官]
讓我們去秘密基地吧！

scripts.text:
[Eden Teleport Officer]
If you don't know what to do for your future, don't hesitate to tell me. Just drop by and talk to me! Ok?
scripts.translation:
[樂園團傳送官]
如果您不知道未來該做什麼，請毫不猶豫地告訴我。隨時過來和我聊聊！好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lime Evenor]
Oh, it is an exclusive place only for Eden's members.
If you are a member, you can come whenever you want!
scripts.translation:
[萊姆·艾弗諾]
哦，這是樂園團成員專用的地方。
如果您是成員，隨時都可以來！

scripts.text: Enter.
scripts.translation: 進入

scripts.text: Don't Enter.
scripts.translation: 不進入

scripts.text: This door is beautifully decorated but seems a little bit too heavy.
scripts.translation: 這扇門裝飾得很漂亮，但看起來有點太重了。

scripts.text:
[Lime Evenor]
Well, if you are not interested.
scripts.translation:
[萊姆·艾弗諾]
好吧，如果您不感興趣的話。

scripts.text:
[Lime Evenor]
Oh, this is an exclusive place for Eden's members only.
If you want to go inside, you have to join the Eden Group.
scripts.translation:
[萊姆·艾弗諾]
哦，這是樂園團成員專用的地方。
如果您想進去，必須加入樂園團。

scripts.text:
[Old Adventurer]
Harsh, I am strong enough even if I look old! What is her name? Lime Evenor? She just ignores me like I am a some kind of old senile bastard.
scripts.translation:
[年老的冒險者]
真是苛刻，雖然我看起來老，但我依然很強壯！她叫什麼名字？萊姆·艾弗諾？她就像我是個老糊塗的混蛋一樣無視我。

scripts.text:
[Old Adventurer]
I came here to join the Eden group! I don't deserve this!
Do you also think I look like I'm senile?
scripts.translation:
[年老的冒險者]
我來這裡是為了加入樂園團！我不應該受到這種對待！
你也覺得我看起來像個老糊塗嗎？

scripts.text:
[Eden's Chief]
Oh, Shoot! How many eggs have I done?
Aww!!! I totally forgot! I have to count again!
scripts.translation:
[樂園團首領]
哦，天哪！我到底做了多少個蛋？
哎呀！！！我完全忘了！我得重新數一遍！

scripts.text:
[Eden's Chief]
Why have you asked me to do this? What kind of mission is that?
scripts.translation:
[樂園團首領]
你為什麼要我這麼做？這是什麼任務？

scripts.text:
[Eden's Chief]
What are you going to with all of those fried eggs? I am sure you can't eat all of them. You just want to bother me, right?
scripts.translation:
[樂園團首領]
你打算拿這些煎蛋做什麼？我肯定你吃不完。你只是想惹我生氣，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Eden's Intern]
Actually, I realized that.
scripts.translation:
[樂園團實習生]
其實，我也意識到了。

scripts.text:
[Eden's Intern]
We have to work really hard unless you want to fail.
scripts.translation:
[樂園團實習生]
除非你想失敗，否則我們必須非常努力。

scripts.text:
[Eden's Intern]
But, I have never learned about pharmaceuticals yet.
scripts.translation:
[樂園團實習生]
但是，我還沒有學過藥學。

scripts.text:
[Eden's Intern]
I'm going to fail. I can't do this.
scripts.translation:
[樂園團實習生]
我要失敗了。我做不到。

scripts.text:
[Neede]
I became a Eden's member several years ago, but it feels like it was yesterday.
I have been doing lots of work, so I didn't even notice how many years I spent here.
scripts.translation:
[尼德]
我幾年前就成為了樂園團的成員，但感覺就像昨天一樣。
我一直都在努力工作，甚至沒注意到在這裡度過了多少年。

scripts.text:
[Neede]
It reminds me that it was like a war everyday.
scripts.translation:
[尼德]
這讓我想起，這裡每天都像打仗一樣。

scripts.text:
[Neede]
The chief of ^3131FFthe restaurant on the right side^000000
uses too much seasoning every time he cooks, the smell is all over the lobby. We have to open the window regularly because we can't stand the smell!
scripts.translation:
[尼德]
^3131FF右邊那家餐廳^000000的首領每次做飯都放太多調料，味道瀰漫了整個大廳。我們不得不經常開窗，因為實在受不了那個味道！

scripts.text:
[Neede]
And, do you see the ^3131FFgymnasium^000000 on the cross of ^3131FFthe north side of the lobby^000000? They always shout when they exercise, I can even hear them from here!
scripts.translation:
[尼德]
還有，你看到^3131FF大廳北側十字路口^000000的^3131FF健身房^000000了嗎？他們鍛鍊時總是大喊大叫，我甚至在這裡都能聽到！

scripts.text:
[Neede]
Besides, the weird girl from ^3131FFthe second floor^000000 is crying all the time. Her cries drive me crazy.
scripts.translation:
[尼德]
此外，^3131FF二樓^000000那個奇怪的女孩總是在哭。她的哭聲讓我抓狂。

scripts.text:
[Neede]
Ah, that weird girl is actually our boss...
scripts.translation:
[尼德]
啊，那個奇怪的女孩其實是我們的老闆...

scripts.text:
[Neede]
I don't know what she has been up to. But she cries and shouts all the time. Oh, sometimes I hear 'Bang!', loud booming sounds... I don't know where it came from.
scripts.translation:
[尼德]
我不知道她在搞什麼。但她總是又哭又喊。哦，有時我還會聽到“砰！”的巨響...我不知道那聲音是從哪裡傳來的。

scripts.text:
[Neede]
Wait!
Shh! It is a secret, you can't tell anybody!
scripts.translation:
[尼德]
等等！
噓！這是個秘密，你不能告訴任何人！

scripts.text:
[Neede]
I don't trust Evenor. She never shows her feelings... she's going to snitch on me to my boss.
scripts.translation:
[尼德]
我不信任艾弗諾。她從不表露自己的感情...她肯定會向我的老闆告密。

scripts.text:
[Lime Evenor]
I am not that kind of girl.
scripts.translation:
[萊姆·艾弗諾]
我不是那種女孩。

scripts.text:
[Neede]
Huh? Did you hear that? Gosh~!
scripts.translation:
[尼德]
咦？你聽到了嗎？天哪~！
